entities.summary: Maximilian Franzreb is a German professional ice hockey player who is a goaltender for Adler Mannheim of the Deutsche Eishockey Liga (DEL). Previously, Franzreb played for the Eisbären Berlin and Fischtown Pinguins in the DEL.
